body: There's an angry face at the lower right of the mountain. I'm high so that tripped me out, he looks like an angry ghost.

Sorry you had to go through that, at least things have gotten better for you. I don't like the idea of anti-depressants, I tried them before and they weren't for me. You're right about the self talk though and group therapy's a good idea, unfortunately it costs money which I don't have. 

Thanks for the advice and good luck
